name: unitree-h2-velocity-history-v0
description: NVIDIA Isaac Sim public bundle for the Unitree H2: Velocity-H2-History-v0 locomotion policy (TorchScript MLP 255 -> 14, trained on PhysX in AGILE) and the URDF-USD-Converter H2 asset. The two YAML files are vendored verbatim under assets/h2/bundle/ (Apache-2.0, SPDX headers kept; outside configs/ because they are NVIDIA training exports, not CASCADE profiles); policy.pt and the USD are fetched from the public asset root and verified against these digests, never committed.

policy.pt.license: Isaac Sim asset terms (no licence file in the bundle)

H2.usda.note: Stub stage; references ./payloads/base.usda and the Physics variant payloads (physics/physx/mujoco). The composed stage identity is bound at open by the owner, not by this digest.
H2.usda.source: URDF-USD-Converter output of unitreerobotics/unitree_ros robots/h2_description (31 revolute joints, BSD-3)

training.training_usd: Isaac/Robots/Unitree/H2/H2.usda with variants collision_profile=feet_only, hands=none (not defined by the public stub; record the active colliders at open)
